response.sql: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref AS project_reference, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT g.project_reference, g.funding_source, g.rate, g.rate - b.rate AS excess FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.rate ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A zero scan duration makes the size-per-minute ratio undefined, so that scan is ignored when averaging ratios.
